narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>The highest common factor is always the common multiplier.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>That works only if the other two numbers share nothing.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>If they share a factor, the answer is bigger.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Remember, always ask what the other two numbers share.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Your turn, find the highest common factor of thirteen times six and thirteen times eight.
